import MumfordLib.SingularCohomologyMayerVietorisCup

/-!
# Naturality of the singular Mayer--Vietoris connecting map

A continuous map respecting two open covers commutes with the connecting
homomorphism. The proof pulls back the cochain lifts computing the connecting
class, including their global cocycle representatives.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

noncomputable section

open CategoryTheory

namespace Mumford.Analytic

variable {X Y : TopCat}

/-- A continuous map restricted to subsets which it preserves. -/
def singularSubsetContinuousMap (f : X ⟶ Y) {U : Set X} {W : Set Y}
    (h : Set.MapsTo f U W) : TopCat.of U ⟶ TopCat.of W :=
  TopCat.ofHom ⟨fun x => ⟨f x.1, h x.2⟩,
    (f.hom.continuous.comp continuous_subtype_val).subtype_mk _⟩

@[reassoc (attr := simp)]
theorem singularSubsetContinuousMap_inclusion (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {U : Set X} {W : Set Y} (h : Set.MapsTo f U W) :
    singularSubsetContinuousMap f h ≫ singularSubsetInclusion Y W =
      singularSubsetInclusion X U ≫ f := rfl

private def singularSubsetSimplicialMap (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {U : Set X} {W : Set Y} (h : Set.MapsTo f U W) :
    (singularSubset X U).toSSet ⟶ (singularSubset Y W).toSSet :=
  (singularSubsetIso X U).inv ≫
    TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetContinuousMap f h) ≫
      (singularSubsetIso Y W).hom

@[reassoc]
private theorem singularSubsetSimplicialMap_inclusion (f : X ⟶ Y)
    {U : Set X} {W : Set Y} (h : Set.MapsTo f U W) :
    singularSubsetSimplicialMap f h ≫ (singularSubset Y W).ι =
      (singularSubset X U).ι ≫ TopCat.toSSet.map f := by
  dsimp [singularSubsetSimplicialMap]
  rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, singularSubsetIso_hom_ι,
    ← Functor.map_comp, singularSubsetContinuousMap_inclusion, Functor.map_comp,
    ← singularSubsetIso_hom_ι, Category.assoc, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

private def singularIntersectionIso (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) :
    TopCat.toSSet.obj (TopCat.of (U ∩ V : Set X)) ≅
      (singularSubset X U ⊓ singularSubset X V).toSSet :=
  singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X) ≪≫
    SSet.Subcomplex.eqToIso (singularSubset_inter X U V)

@[reassoc]
private theorem singularIntersectionIso_hom_inclusion (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) :
    (singularIntersectionIso X U V).hom ≫
        (singularSubset X U ⊓ singularSubset X V).ι =
      TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X (U ∩ V : Set X)) := by
  simp only [singularIntersectionIso, Iso.trans_hom, Category.assoc]
  change (singularSubsetIso X (U ∩ V : Set X)).hom ≫
    SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE (singularSubset_inter X U V).le ≫
      (singularSubset X U ⊓ singularSubset X V).ι = _
  rw [SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE_ι, singularSubsetIso_hom_ι]

@[reassoc]
private theorem singularIntersectionIso_inv_inclusion (X : TopCat) (U V : Set X) :
    (singularIntersectionIso X U V).inv ≫
        TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X (U ∩ V : Set X)) =
      (singularSubset X U ⊓ singularSubset X V).ι := by
  rw [← singularIntersectionIso_hom_inclusion, Iso.inv_hom_id_assoc]

/-- Naturality of the connecting homomorphism on cocycle representatives. -/
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_naturality_class
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (U V : Set X) (W Z : Set Y)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hW : IsOpen W) (hZ : IsOpen Z)
    (hcoverX : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (hcoverY : W ∪ Z = Set.univ)
    (hfU : Set.MapsTo f U W) (hfV : Set.MapsTo f V Z) (n : ℕ)
    (γ : singularCocycles (TopCat.of (W ∩ Z : Set Y)) n) :
    singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcoverX n
      (singularCohomologyClass _ n
        (singularCocyclePullback
          (singularSubsetContinuousMap f (hfU.inter_inter hfV)) n γ)) =
      singularCohomologyPullback f (n + 1)
        (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting Y W Z hW hZ hcoverY n
          (singularCohomologyClass _ n γ)) := by
  let A := singularSubset X U
  let B := singularSubset X V
  let C := singularSubset Y W
  let D := singularSubset Y Z
  let fA := singularSubsetSimplicialMap f hfU
  let fB := singularSubsetSimplicialMap f hfV
  let rI := singularSubsetContinuousMap f (hfU.inter_inter hfV)
  let fI := (singularIntersectionIso X U V).inv ≫ TopCat.toSSet.map rI ≫
    (singularIntersectionIso Y W Z).hom
  have hI : fI ≫ (C ⊓ D).ι = (A ⊓ B).ι ≫ TopCat.toSSet.map f := by
    dsimp [fI, C, D]
    rw [Category.assoc, Category.assoc, singularIntersectionIso_hom_inclusion,
      ← Functor.map_comp]
    change (singularIntersectionIso X U V).inv ≫
      TopCat.toSSet.map (singularSubsetInclusion X (U ∩ V : Set X) ≫ f) = _
    rw [Functor.map_comp, singularIntersectionIso_inv_inclusion_assoc]
  have hIA : fI ≫ SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE (inf_le_left : C ⊓ D ≤ C) =
      SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE (inf_le_left : A ⊓ B ≤ A) ≫ fA := by
    apply (cancel_mono C.ι).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc, SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE_ι]
    rw [hI, singularSubsetSimplicialMap_inclusion, SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE_ι_assoc]
  have hIB : fI ≫ SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE (inf_le_right : C ⊓ D ≤ D) =
      SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE (inf_le_right : A ⊓ B ≤ B) ≫ fB := by
    apply (cancel_mono D.ι).mp
    simp only [Category.assoc, SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE_ι]
    rw [hI, singularSubsetSimplicialMap_inclusion, SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE_ι_assoc]
  have hIq : fI ≫ (singularIntersectionIso Y W Z).inv =
      (singularIntersectionIso X U V).inv ≫ TopCat.toSSet.map rI := by
    simp [fI]
  obtain ⟨α, β, θ, hγ, hθ⟩ := singularCocycle_exists_mayerVietoris_lift
    Y W Z hW hZ hcoverY n γ
  rw [singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_class_of_lift
    Y W Z hW hZ hcoverY n γ α β θ hγ hθ, singularCohomologyPullback_class]
  apply singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_class_of_lift
    X U V hU hV hcoverX n _
    (simplicialCochainPullback fA n α) (simplicialCochainPullback fB n β)
    (singularCocyclePullback f (n + 1) θ)
  · have h := congrArg (simplicialCochainPullback fI n) hγ
    change simplicialCochainPullback fI n
      (simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left) n α -
        simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right) n β) =
      simplicialCochainPullback fI n
        (simplicialCochainPullback (singularIntersectionIso Y W Z).inv n γ.1) at h
    rw [map_sub, ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp,
      ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, hIA, hIB, hIq] at h
    change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_left) n
        (simplicialCochainPullback fA n α) -
      simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE inf_le_right) n
        (simplicialCochainPullback fB n β) =
      simplicialCochainPullback (singularIntersectionIso X U V).inv n
        (simplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map rI) n γ.1)
    simpa only [simplicialCochainPullback_comp] using h
  · have hθA := congrArg Prod.fst hθ
    have hθB := congrArg Prod.snd hθ
    change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left) (n + 1)
      (simplicialCochainPullback (C ⊔ D).ι (n + 1) θ.1) =
      simplicialCochainDifferential C n α at hθA
    change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right) (n + 1)
      (simplicialCochainPullback (C ⊔ D).ι (n + 1) θ.1) =
      simplicialCochainDifferential D n β at hθB
    rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE_ι] at hθA hθB
    apply Prod.ext
    · change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_left) (n + 1)
        (simplicialCochainPullback (A ⊔ B).ι (n + 1)
          (simplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map f) (n + 1) θ.1)) =
        simplicialCochainDifferential A n (simplicialCochainPullback fA n α)
      rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE_ι,
        ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, ← singularSubsetSimplicialMap_inclusion f hfU,
        simplicialCochainPullback_comp, hθA, simplicialCochainPullback_differential]
    · change simplicialCochainPullback (SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE le_sup_right) (n + 1)
        (simplicialCochainPullback (A ⊔ B).ι (n + 1)
          (simplicialCochainPullback (TopCat.toSSet.map f) (n + 1) θ.1)) =
        simplicialCochainDifferential B n (simplicialCochainPullback fB n β)
      rw [← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, SSet.Subcomplex.homOfLE_ι,
        ← simplicialCochainPullback_comp, ← singularSubsetSimplicialMap_inclusion f hfV,
        simplicialCochainPullback_comp, hθB, simplicialCochainPullback_differential]

/-- The ordinary singular Mayer--Vietoris connecting map is natural for
continuous maps respecting the two open sets. -/
theorem singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_naturality
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (U V : Set X) (W Z : Set Y)
    (hU : IsOpen U) (hV : IsOpen V) (hW : IsOpen W) (hZ : IsOpen Z)
    (hcoverX : U ∪ V = Set.univ) (hcoverY : W ∪ Z = Set.univ)
    (hfU : Set.MapsTo f U W) (hfV : Set.MapsTo f V Z) (n : ℕ)
    (c : IntegralSingularCohomology (TopCat.of (W ∩ Z : Set Y)) n) :
    singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting X U V hU hV hcoverX n
      (singularCohomologyPullback
        (singularSubsetContinuousMap f (hfU.inter_inter hfV)) n c) =
      singularCohomologyPullback f (n + 1)
        (singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting Y W Z hW hZ hcoverY n c) := by
  obtain ⟨γ, rfl⟩ := singularCohomologyClass_surjective _ n c
  rw [singularCohomologyPullback_class]
  exact singularCohomologyMayerVietorisConnecting_naturality_class
    f U V W Z hU hV hW hZ hcoverX hcoverY hfU hfV n γ

end Mumford.Analytic
